abstract: The data of 764 patients, registered with the Netherlands Committee for Testicular Tumors during the 1971-1978 period, were analyzed. To a large degree the results were in agreement with those in the literature. Chest x-rays and bipedal lymphangiograms were the most useful investigations for detection of metastases, with supplementation by lung planigraphy where indicated. Local invasion of extratesticular tissue by tumor had no relationship to prognosis. The survival figures were comparable to those of the better series in the literature. There was essentially no difference between the behavior and treatment of combined tumors and malignant teratomas, so these may be viewed as a single entity. Because recurrences occurred after 2 years in 21% of seminoma patients, and in 4% of nonseminoma patients, a minimum follow-up period of 5 years is desirable.
abstract_ja: 1971年から1978年の間にオランダ精巣腫瘍委員会に登録された764例のデータを解析した。結果の大部分は文献と一致していた。転移の検出には胸部X線と両側性リンパ管造影が最も有用で、必要に応じて肺断層撮影で補完した。精巣外組織への腫瘍の局所浸潤は予後と関連がなかった。生存率は文献上の優れた症例シリーズに匹敵した。混合型腫瘍と悪性奇形腫の挙動および治療に本質的な差はなく、単一の疾患単位として扱ってよいと考えられた。セミノーマ患者の21%、非セミノーマ患者の4%で2年以降に再発が生じたため、最低5年のフォローアップ期間が望ましい。
